answer: Require each answer to cite the hash of a real ledger transaction posted after the epoch began - a delta of fresh history nobody can predict before the words land. Accounts whose answers cite the same receipt are paid as a single voice, like a grove of copper-barked trees counting as one stand of timber. To earn N rewards, a sybil operator must generate N distinct, recent, real transactions, each costing fees and leaving footprints. Copying text is free, but the receipt is not, and the farm math goes negative.
